# UTF-4088 Front-End Registry — Ordered Table

This document contains all **16,606** deterministic front-end registry records,
ordered by `integer_id` (0 through 16605 inclusive).

The records are generated by the canonical **UTF4088-RG-1** algorithm
(`generate_frontend_registry()` in `registry_generator.cpp`). This table was
produced by running that generator directly, so it matches the C++
implementation exactly. See [registry_manifest.json](registry_manifest.json)
and [character_map.hpp](character_map.hpp) for the authoritative schema.

## Generation rules (UTF4088-RG-1)

| field | derivation |
|---|---|
| `integer_id` | `0 .. 16605` inclusive |
| `stage` | `id % 3` → `start`, `intermediate`, `final` |
| `language` | `(id / 3) % 3` → `american-english`, `korean`, `germanic` |
| `codepoint` | `0x110000 + id` (experimental range, above Unicode max; **not** a Unicode scalar value) |
| `shape_id` | `SplitMix64(id ^ 0x5348415045)` |
| `meaning_id` | `SplitMix64(id ^ 0x4D45414E494E47)` |

> **Note:** These are experimental identifiers and rendering/semantic slots.
> A code point in this table is **not** an assertion of an established Unicode
> character, nor does it carry human-language meaning without explicit
> annotation. See the disclaimers in [README.md](README.md).
